facts.text: The Hilltopper Guarantee provides 100% tuition coverage for eligible Kentucky freshmen who receive Pell and CAP grants with at least a 3.0 high school GPA.

sources.title: The Hilltopper Guarantee | Western Kentucky University
sources.quote: WKU guarantees 100% tuition coverage for any first-time, first-year freshman from Kentucky who receives Pell and KY College Access Program Grant assistance and has at least a 3.0 cumulative unweighted high school GPA.
